summary.text: Sheldon Prout is the Republican candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives, District 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Kodiak native from a commercial fishing family, he says he has declined party and political action committee money.

paragraphs.text: Sheldon Prout graduated from Kodiak High School and received a bachelor's degree from Utah Tech University in 2023.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he comes from a third-generation commercial fishing family, has worked in the industry himself, and was born and raised in Kodiak.
Prout said in the survey that he would represent his district rather than a party and has declined party and PAC money.

He listed his priorities as representation on the Board of Fisheries and a tax credit for in-state seafood processing, restoring year-round ferry service for Cordova and Kodiak, and education funding through a Base Student Allocation that is not re-fought each session, along with a defined-benefit retirement option for teachers.
